newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Fook Kong says in stake sale talk.
newsitem.headline: Sun Fook Kong says in stake sale talk.

text.p: Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its controlling shareholders were discussing the sale of all or part of their stake in the company.

The construction and civil engineering group said certain controlling shareholders, holding a stake of about 49 percent, were in discussion with a third party which might lead to a disposal of some or all of their holding in the company.
"Discussions were at a preliminary stage and no agreement has been reached," it said.
It said the disposal may or may not give rise to a change in control of the company.
